newsitem.title: USA: Lunn Industries signs merger deal with TPG.
newsitem.headline: Lunn Industries signs merger deal with TPG.

text.p: Lunn Industries Inc said Tuesday that its board of directors approved a stock-for-stock merger with TPG Holdings Inc, a private company that designs, develops and manufactures composite material products for the aerospace and defense industries.
The two companies entered into an acquisition agreement in which Lunn stockholders would retain about 26 percent of the combined entity on a fully diluted basis.

Lunn stockholders would receive one share of the combined company's common stock in exchange for every ten outstanding shares of Lunn's common stock and TPG stockholders would receive about 8.3 shares of the combined company's common stock in exchange for each outstanding share of TPG common stock.
In 1996, TPG earned $4.3 million on revenues of $126.5 million, compared to $4.8 million on revenues of $144.6 million in 1995.
